Assessment of BA.evidence_source: Following best-practice recommendations for the test adaptation of body image instruments (Swami & Barron, 2018), we translated the BAS-2 from English to Malay using the five-stage procedure proposed by Beaton, Bombardier, Guillemin, and Ferraz, (2000).

section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the five-stage Beaton et al. (2000) translation and adaptation procedure used to translate the BAS-2 into Malay, including forward/back translations, committee review, and minor item revisions. It reports a pre-test of the prefinal Malay BAS-2 in a sample of 40 Malay-fluent individuals (women = 60.0%), with mean item understanding overall M = 3.98 (SD = 0.46) and four items with Ms < 4.0 returned for further revision.
section_summary.evidence_source: Full section text describing translation steps and pretest: "In a fifth step,the pre-tested in a sample of 40 individuals (women = 60.0%) who were fluent in Malay. These participants were asked to rate each item for understanding on a 5-point scale ... overall M = 3.98, SD = 0.46, range = 3.57–4.47 ... 4 items with relatively lower ratings of understanding (Ms < 4.0) were returned to the committee for further consideration."
